title: South Burlington, VT — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to South Burlington, VT: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

South Burlington is a city in VT with a population of 20,000. Champlain Valley city with the Vermont National Guard and excellent schools. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
